goal: Iske baad aap aisa function likh sakte hain jo structure return kare (Student read(), Point add(Point a, Point b)), usay kai values ek saath wapas karne ke liye use kar sakte hain, aur samjha sakte hain ke local variable ka pointer kabhi return kyun nahi karna chahiye.
warmup: University ke fee counter par aap apna roll number dete hain aur clerk aap ko EK parchi deta hai jis par aap ka naam, total fee aur due date saath chhapi hoti hai. Aap ko teen alag kaghaz nahi chahiye the. Structure return karne wala function wohi parchi hai: ek object jo kai related jawab saath le kar aata hai.
definition: Function ki return type structure ho sakti hai, maslan Point add(Point a, Point b). Function ek structure banata hai (aksar local variable r), aur return r; poora structure wapas bhej deta hai. Call karne wale ko copy milti hai aur woh usay aam tor par apne variable mein rakhta hai: Point s = add(p, q);. Yeh kai values ek saath wapas karne ka saaf tareeqa hai, kyunke aam return sirf ek value wapas de sakta hai lekin structure kai members rakh sakta hai.
howItWorks: Pehla trace aur call stack dekhein. add ke apne boxes a, b aur r hain. Jab return r; chalta hai, to teeno boxes khatam hone wale hote hain, is liye C++ r ki values ko us jagah copy kar deta hai jahan result chahiye: main ka variable s. Isi liye structure ko BY VALUE return karna mehfooz hai: s ki apni copy hai. Doosra trace kai jawabon ka pattern dikhata hai: evaluate total, average aur grade calculate karta hai, unhein Result mein rakhta hai aur return kar deta hai. main mein res.total, res.average aur res.grade teeno jawab dete hain. Values wapas dene ka ek aur tareeqa bhi hai: reference parameter pass karein aur usay bharein, jaise void evaluate(int m1, int m2, int m3, Result &r). Return karna aam tor par parhne mein aasaan hota hai, kyunke call evaluate(80, 75, 90) ko value ki tarah use kiya ja sakta hai. Reference bharne se copy bach jati hai, jo sirf bohat bare structures ke liye ahmiyat rakhta hai. Khatre ki jagah: kisi local variable ka pointer ya reference kabhi return na karein (maslan return &s; jahan s local structure ho). Local variable function khatam hone par destroy ho jata hai, is liye pointer ek mare hue box ki taraf ishara karta hai. g++ warning deta hai 'address of local variable returned', aur usay use karne se kachra ya crash milta hai. Is ke bajaye structure ko by value return karein.
